crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

translations.web: The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is weary. He awakens morning by morning, he awakens my ear to hear as those who are taught.
translations.bsb: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.
translations.kjv: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
translations.asv: The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of them that are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as they that are taught.
